subject: Project Update Needed
body: Hi, could you share the current status of the project? We need the progress report before Friday. Please include all completed milestones, pending tasks, known risks, and any items that may require leadership approval. Make sure to attach the updated Gantt chart and resource allocation details. Thanks!

subject: Your Order Has Shipped
body: Your package has been shipped and is expected to arrive between Jan 12–15. You can track your shipment through your Amazon account. If you will not be available during the delivery window, please update your delivery preferences. Thank you for shopping with us!

subject: Important: Submit Documents
body: Please submit your onboarding documents by tomorrow evening. This includes your identification forms, bank details, signed company policy agreements, and your emergency contact information. Failure to submit on time might delay your payroll activation.

subject: Q1 Campaign Strategy Review
body: Hello team, we are scheduling a full review of the Q1 campaign strategy. Please prepare your insights on audience targeting, social media engagement results, and creative performance metrics. We will also discuss potential collaborations with external partners for greater outreach.

subject: Your Subscription Renewal
body: Your Spotify Premium subscription will renew automatically on January 13th. You will be charged using your default payment method. To make changes to your plan or payment information, visit your account settings. Thank you for being a Premium member!

subject: Don’t Forget the Family Dinner
body: Hi dear! Just a reminder that we’re having a family dinner this Sunday evening. Everyone will be there, and we're planning to cook your favorite dishes. Let me know if you’re bringing anything or if you’ll arrive late. Love you!

subject: Security Alert: New Login Detected
body: A new login to your GitHub account was detected from a device we don’t recognize. If this was you, please ignore this message. Otherwise, we strongly recommend you review your security settings, change your password, and enable two-factor authentication immediately.

subject: We Added New Shows You Might Like
body: Based on your viewing history, we’ve added several new shows we think you’ll enjoy. From thrilling dramas to action-packed originals, there’s something for everyone. Check the ‘New Releases’ section on your homepage for personalized recommendations.

subject: Expense Report Deadline
body: This is a reminder to submit all expense reports for last quarter before January 15th. Please include all receipts, travel confirmations, and vendor invoices. Reimbursements will be processed only after full documentation is provided.

subject: Scheduled Maintenance Notice
body: Please be informed that the company’s internal servers will undergo scheduled maintenance on January 12th between 1:00 AM and 5:00 AM. During this time, intranet services and file-sharing systems may be temporarily inaccessible. We appreciate your patience.

subject: People Are Viewing Your Profile
body: Your profile has seen increased activity this week. To find out who viewed your profile and what searches you are appearing in, visit your dashboard. Updating your skills may help you appear in more recruiter searches.

subject: Monthly Statement Ready
body: Your monthly bank statement for December is now available. You can download it from your online banking dashboard. If you notice any unauthorized activity, please contact customer support immediately.

subject: You Have Unread Messages
body: You have several unread messages in your workspace channels. Some may require your attention, including mentions from your team leads. Log in to your Slack account to review ongoing discussions and action items.

subject: Unusual Activity in Your Account
body: We detected unusual activity in your Google account. If you made the recent changes, please disregard this message. Otherwise, we strongly recommend reviewing your recent activity and updating your password.

subject: Meeting Agenda for Monday
body: Hi all, attached is the agenda for Monday’s meeting. We will be covering sprint progress, blockers, planned deployments, and the upcoming feature rollout schedule. Please come prepared with your updates and any support you need.
